event_name: Document 55 Date 19 July 2020 Time 20:06 2020 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 July 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 38), summoned (document 41) and heard from the team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
